acceptanceCriteria: work-item outcome never reports green or verified from file presence alone
verification evidence is schema-checked and must bind passed=true, the requested workItemId, repositoryId, repositorySnapshotDigest, and runtime identity before a green Outcome is possible
tampering with passed, workItemId, repositoryId, repositorySnapshotDigest, runtime identity, or malformed evidence produces a fail-closed red or not-ready Outcome and never a green claim
recorded verification evidence includes repositoryId and remains compatible with existing runtime and protocol evidence readers
human Outcome preserves a readable section layout and emits localized red/yellow/green markers for Chinese, Japanese, and English
regression tests cover missing, malformed, tampered, cross-work-item, cross-repository, stale-snapshot, and runtime-mismatch verification evidence
trilingual Outcome documentation describes evidence validation, fail-closed behavior, and the distinction between authored acceptance text and localized system labels
goal: 根治 Outcome 仅凭 evidence 文件存在就宣称成功的 fail-open 路径，并让验证证据绑定 repository identity 后再供人类结果展示使用。
intent: 修复被篡改、跨 Work Item、跨 repository、过期或 runtime 不匹配的 verification evidence 仍显示 🟢 成功的问题；同时保留面向人的三语 Outcome 和状态标记。
outOfScope: changing the public v0.2.4 Release truth or tag
changing repository configuration format or migration semantics
translating arbitrary user-authored acceptance criteria without a source-language contract
